描述_EN: when it is wound up the train engine moves on two wheels set under the centre which are connected to the mechanism. the toy was made in china for export to the west. a clockwork mechanism is housed inside the body. the funnel has a cone shaped piece of plastic simulating smoke that spins around when the train is in motion. this christmas themed train engine is lithographed tinplate.
描述_ZN: 当它被上紧发条时，火车引擎在中心下方的两个轮子上移动，这些轮子与机械装置相连。 该玩具是在中国制造的，用于出口到西方。 机身内有一个发条装置。 漏斗有一个圆锥形的塑料片，模拟火车行驶时的烟雾，旋转着。 这个以圣诞为主题的火车引擎是石版印刷的马口铁。
